content_sections.heading: Quick Summary
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Basic Education Officer (BSA), Gorakhpur, functioning under Samagra Shiksha, has released a notification (No. SSSO/BASHI/6585–92, dated 14.09.2026) inviting applications for contract-based (Samvida) teaching and non-teaching posts in 20 Kasturba Gandhi Awasiya Balika Vidyalayas (Classes 6–8) and upgraded Kasturba Gandhi Awasiya Balika Vidyalayas (Classes 9–12) in Gorakhpur district. Recruiting Body: District Basic Education Officer (BSA), Gorakhpur Posts : Principal, PGT (Hindi, English, Maths, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Computer Science), Full-Time Teacher, Part-Time Teacher, Accountant, Lab Assistant, Office Superintendent/Clerk, Head Cook, Assistant Cook, Peon, Chowkidar Total Vacancies: 132 (48 for Classes 6–8 + 84 for Classes 9–12) Eligible Candidates: Only female candidates Last Date to Apply: 30 September 2026, till 5:00 PM Application Mode: Offline only - by Registered Post/Speed Post Job Location: Kasturba Gandhi Awasiya Balika Vidyalayas, District Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh

content_sections.heading: BSA Gorakhpur KGBV Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The District Basic Education Officer (BSA) Gorakhpur, also referred to as the Office of the District Basic Education Officer, has invited applications from eligible, qualified female candidates only for contract-based teacher and non-teaching staff posts for the academic session 2026–27, in Kasturba Gandhi Awasiya Balika Vidyalayas (Classes 6–8) and upgraded Kasturba Gandhi Awasiya Balika Vidyalayas (Classes 9–12) operating in Gorakhpur district. Register for Job Alerts

content_sections.heading: BSA Gorakhpur KGBV Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications received after 30.09.2026, 5:00 PM will not be accepted, and applications submitted through any mode other than Registered Post/Speed Post will not be accepted.

content_sections.text: Grand Total Vacancies: 132 posts Vacancy numbers for each category/reservation group may increase or decrease as per the notification, and category-wise reservation will be finalised by the selection committee.

content_sections.heading: BSA Gorakhpur KGBV Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible to apply for all posts under this recruitment. Post-specific educational qualification requirements are detailed below and in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: BSA Gorakhpur KGBV Qualification
content_sections.text: Qualification requirements vary by post and are specified in detail in the official notification. A summary: Principal: Postgraduate with B.Ed., along with prescribed teaching/administrative experience as per notification norms. PGT (Hindi/English/Maths/Biology/Chemistry/Physics/Computer Science): Relevant postgraduate degree with B.Ed. or equivalent training qualification in the respective subject. Full-Time Teacher (Classes 6–8): Graduate with B.Ed./equivalent training qualification, subject-specific as listed in the vacancy table. Part-Time Teacher (Computer): Graduate in Computer Science/related field or equivalent recognized computer qualification, as specified in the notification. Part-Time Teacher (Art, Craft & Music): Graduate with relevant training qualification in Art/Craft or Music. Accountant: Graduate in Commerce with knowledge of MS Office/Computer accounting; Computer Diploma preferred. Lab Assistant: High School/Intermediate (Science) with a laboratory technique diploma, as specified in the notification. Office Superintendent/Clerk: Intermediate pass with computer typing proficiency (Hindi minimum 25 words/minute, English minimum 30 words/minute) and a recognized computer certificate. Head Cook/Assistant Cook/Peon/Chowkidar: Class 8 pass; candidates must not be suffering from any physical disability or infectious disease. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the complete qualification details applicable to their specific post.

content_sections.heading: BSA Gorakhpur KGBV Age Limit
content_sections.text: General posts: Minimum 25 years – Maximum 45 years (as on 1 April 2026) Principal: Minimum 30 years – Maximum 45 years (as on 1 April 2026) Age relaxation will be given as per state government rules. Maximum service age for existing staff continuing in Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas is 60 years, subject to the conditions specified in the notification. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: BSA Gorakhpur KGBV Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is not specified in the provided notification. Candidates are only required to enclose three self-addressed envelopes with their correspondence address, each affixed with a ₹58 postage stamp, along with the application.

content_sections.heading: BSA Gorakhpur KGBV Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made as follows, as per the notification: Principal, PGT posts, Full-Time Teacher, Part-Time Teacher, Accountant, and Lab Assistant: Direct selection based on merit (quality marks derived from academic percentage). Office Superintendent/Clerk: Selection based on a typing test. Head Cook, Assistant Cook, Peon, and Chowkidar: Selection through interview. If two or more candidates have equal quality marks, preference is given to the older candidate; if age is also equal, the candidates are listed in English alphabetical order of names.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BSA Gorakhpur KGBV Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: This recruitment does not have an online application process. Applications must be submitted offline, in the prescribed format, by Registered Post or Speed Post only. Download the prescribed application format from the official Gorakhpur district website: https://gorakhpur.nic.in Fill the application clearly in your own handwriting or typed, following the format exactly (no cutting or overwriting is permitted). Attach self-attested copies of required certificates: educational mark sheets/certificates, training certificates, character certificate, date-of-birth proof, residence proof, and caste certificate (if applicable). Enclose three self-addressed envelopes, each affixed with a ₹58 postal stamp. Submit a separate application for each post/category applied for. Send the completed application via Registered Post/Speed Post to: Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Sitapur Aankh Ka Aspatal Campus, Park Road, Gorakhpur – 273001 Ensure the application reaches the above address by 30 September 2026, 5:00 PM. Applications submitted through any other mode, or received after the deadline, will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q1. What is BSA Gorakhpur KGBV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the District Basic Education Officer, Gorakhpur, to fill 132 contract-based teaching and non-teaching posts in Kasturba Gandhi Awasiya Balika Vidyalayas (Classes 6–8 and 9–12) for the 2026–27 session.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 132 vacancies - 48 for Classes 6–8 posts and 84 for Classes 9–12 posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
Q4. Who is eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Only female candidates meeting the post-specific educational qualification and age criteria are eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Generally 25–45 years (as on 1 April 2026); for Principal posts, 30–45 years.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply online?
faq.answer: No. This recruitment is offline only; applications must be sent via Registered Post/Speed Post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Direct merit-based selection for Principal, PGT, Teacher, Accountant, and Lab Assistant posts; a typing test for Office Superintendent/Clerk; and an interview for Cook, Peon, and Chowkidar posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Salary ranges from ₹5,978 to ₹30,000 per month depending on the post, as detailed in the salary table above.
